about.heading: Turning Technology into Business Impact
paragraphs: Wayne Poon is a Malaysian technology entrepreneur and the Founder & CEO of Webtek Sdn Bhd — a technology company specialising in mobile applications, software development, AI automation, and digital platform solutions.
Webtek helps businesses transform digitally by building scalable, intelligent, and user-friendly systems that improve efficiency, reduce operational costs, and create better customer experiences.

Wayne leads the company with a belief that technology should be accessible, efficient, and cost-effective — empowering businesses and entrepreneurs to compete confidently in an increasingly digital marketplace.
about.shortBio: Wayne Poon is the Founder & CEO of Webtek Sdn Bhd, providing software development, automation, and digital solutions for SMEs and startups. Passionate about technology, AI, and digital transformation, he helps businesses operate efficiently and scale sustainably.
about.storyText: Wayne founded Webtek Sdn Bhd after observing that many SMEs struggled with manual processes and inefficient workflows. He set out to create digital solutions that reduce repetitive tasks, optimize operations, and let business owners focus on what matters — growth.

expertise.title: Custom Software Development
expertise.description: Enterprise software, web applications, and cloud platforms built with PHP, Laravel, Python, C++, and Node.js — tailored precisely to your business needs.

expertise.title: Mobile App Development
expertise.description: High-performance iOS and Android apps built with React Native and Flutter. From e-commerce to on-demand service apps and marketplace platforms.

expertise.title: AI Automation & Smart Systems
expertise.description: Intelligent systems including WhatsApp AI automation, AI chatbots, AI booking systems, and customer service automation that work 24/7.

expertise.title: Digital Platform Solutions
expertise.description: Scalable digital platforms and web applications that streamline operations, improve customer experience, and support business growth.

expertise.title: API Integration
expertise.description: Seamlessly connect your tools, systems, and third-party services through robust API integrations that unify your digital ecosystem.

expertise.title: E-commerce & Marketplace
expertise.description: End-to-end e-commerce and marketplace platforms — including commission-free models — that reduce costs and connect merchants with customers.

expertise.title: WhatsApp AI Customer Service
expertise.description: Automated WhatsApp AI that handles customer inquiries, bookings, and support around the clock without increasing staffing costs.

timeline.description: Leads product development, company strategy, and technology solutions for SMEs and startups. Responsible for architecture decisions, team leadership, and ensuring client success across all digital transformation projects.

Led the company as Chief Executive Officer, overseeing business operations, strategic direction, and team management. Drove the company's growth in digital media and technology services, building a strong foundation of client relationships and operational excellence.

projects.title: Lapar App
projects.description: A commission-free food ordering platform helping restaurants and food vendors sell online without high fees. Lapar App connects merchants directly with customers, lowering costs and creating fairer margins for all.

projects.title: AIRS Hotel Booking System
projects.description: Smart hotel booking system integrated with WhatsApp AI customer service. Automates room bookings, real-time availability, booking confirmations, and 24/7 AI-powered customer inquiries — reducing manual workload.

projects.title: Custom Software & App Development
projects.description: End-to-end custom software development covering web apps, mobile apps (iOS & Android via React Native & Flutter), enterprise systems, cloud platforms, and API integrations tailored to each client's needs.
